name: Comic Book
traits: heavy tapered black ink with spot blacks
hard chiaroscuro from one strong light
dramatic foreshortened poses and tilted framing
flat colour with a single shadow tone and slight print texture
bestFor: high-stakes everyday drama played as heroics
suits: products with a bold silhouette and strong colour (drinks, tools, sports, tech); confident, energetic brands
stylePara: Comic-book art in motion: bold black brush-and-nib ink outlines with tapered weight, thick on the shadow side and thin on the lit side; hard-edged spot blacks carve the forms, with feathered hatching in the half-tones; flat colour fills in a limited saturated palette with one hard cel shadow tone; a faint printed paper texture and slight colour off-register; dramatic chiaroscuro from one strong light; heroic, foreshortened poses and tilted framing; at the most intense moments the background drops to speed lines, a flat colour or a few inked shapes.

rendering.line: tapered brush and nib ink, heavy contour, thinner interior lines, feathered hatching at shadow edges
rendering.shading: spot blacks and one hard cel shadow tone; no soft gradients
rendering.colour: limited saturated flat colours, a dominant hue per scene, product colours exact
rendering.texture: faint paper and print texture, slight off-register colour plates
rendering.lighting: one strong hard key (from below or the side for drama) with deep black shadow shapes

motion: Pose-to-pose limited animation on twos and threes: strong key poses held 8-16 frames, then quick snaps between them with a smear drawing or speed lines; little secondary motion; one impact frame (flat colour flash behind the figure) at the turn; the ink line stays the same weight while moving.
camera: Dutch angles, low worm's-eye and high bird's-eye views, slow push-ins on held poses, a crash zoom for impact; panel layouts and split screens are composed in the edit, never generated.
avoid: speech balloons and sound-effect lettering full of gibberish
ink lines crawling or boiling between frames
soft airbrushed gradients replacing spot blacks
sheets: Characters as an inked model sheet (front, three-quarter, side) plus one dramatic action pose, black-and-white ink with a flat colour version beside it; places as one inked wide with the spot-black pattern; the product inked with a bold outline but exact shape and label colours.
risk: Seedance invents lettering (balloons, onomatopoeia, captions) and drifts toward smooth cel-shaded 3D, and the ink weight thins during long moves. Put 'no speech balloons, no sound-effect lettering, no panel borders' in NO TEXT, write 'hand-inked line, held poses on twos and threes' in MOTION and keep clips 4-6 s; letter balloons and effects in the edit.

example.prompt: Comic-book art still: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange top, drawn in heavy tapered black ink, holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap up toward the low camera in a heroic foreshortened pose, in a sunny kitchen rendered with hard spot blacks; a droopy fern sags on the windowsill behind her; one hard sunlight key from the window, flat saturated colour with one cel shadow tone, feathered hatching, faint print texture, tilted framing. Vertical 9:16. No text.
